description: Phaseo's US-only regional offer for Anthropic's first-party Claude API. It uses the same Anthropic Messages API and model IDs as the direct Anthropic offer, while Phaseo sends inference_geo=us on every supported request.
residency_notes: US-only inference offer for Anthropic's first-party API. Phaseo sends inference_geo=us to POST /v1/messages. Anthropic guarantees US-based inference for Claude 4.6 and later, while workspace geo separately controls storage and endpoint processing and is currently US-only.
prompt_training_notes: Anthropic says customer API data is not used to train its models by default.
user_identifier_notes: Phaseo does not currently send this provider a provider-facing user identifier in the Anthropic chat adapter.
regional_pricing_notes: US-only inference on Claude 4.6 and later is priced at 1.1x the standard rate across input, output, cache-write, and cache-read token categories. Batch requests retain their normal 50% discount before the regional multiplier.

sources.notes: Confirms inference_geo=us on POST /v1/messages, Claude 4.6-and-later coverage, US-only inference, workspace geo behavior, Batch API support, and the 1.1x multiplier.
Confirms the first-party https://api.anthropic.com base URL and the Messages, Message Batches, token counting, and models API surfaces.
Confirms standard API retention, optional ZDR for Messages and data-residency requests, and the separate 29-day retention rule for Message Batches.

verification.notes: Verified as a Phaseo regional routing variant of Anthropic's first-party API, not a separate upstream provider. Local gateway architecture maps only text.generate to the Anthropic executor, uses the direct Anthropic endpoint and credential, and forces inference_geo=us. The catalogue contains exactly the seven Claude 4.6-and-later model IDs currently eligible for this offer; routing activation remains deployment-specific.
